evidence.note: Data source kind declares Authentication with an OAuth record (StartLogin, FinishLogin, Refresh) and UsernamePassword = [].
Builds the OAuth authorize URL and login context.
Username credential branch calls GetApiToken (basic-credential token exchange) and uses the returned token.
Token request to /token/authenticate with Web.Contents; a 401 raises Extension.CredentialError.
Authorize URL carries code_challenge = codeVerifier with code_challenge_method = plain, which is PKCE using the plain method.
Token request sends code_verifier from the stored context on the authorization_code grant.
Refresh callback exchanges oldCredential[refresh_token] with grant_type refresh_token through TokenMethod.
Main GET handler calls Web.Contents for all data requests.
Token exchange calls Web.Contents.
Entry function takes apiUrl and authUrl as text; both are URLs (AnaplanType field captions and samples at 292-303).
Next page is read from resp[meta][paging][next], a URL.
GetAllModels calls itself with @GetAllModels(nextUrl, combined) and combines the results.

paging-stop.text: Paging ends when the response has no meta.paging.next (meta or paging missing, or next is null). The recursion then returns the accumulated models list.

evidence.note: nextUrl is null unless meta.paging.next exists and is not null; result returns combined when nextUrl is null.
Json.Document parses the response body for workspaces, models, exports, and tasks.
Downloaded export file is parsed with Csv.Document (text/csv or text/plain exports).
Exports are filtered to text/csv or text/plain, so the ExcelFormat Excel.Workbook branch at line 583 is not reachable for returned data and is not counted.
Table.FromList then Table.ExpandRecordColumn takes column names from record fields id and name, with no M types assigned.
Column names come from record fields id, name, and currentWorkspaceId; no types are declared.
Column names come from record fields id, name, exportType, and exportFormat; no types are declared.
Export task status request uses Web.Contents with no ManualStatusHandling, so default status handling applies to this live data request.
Data requests set ManualStatusHandling = {401, 404, 500, 501, 502, 503}.
Token call sets ManualStatusHandling = {401} and inspects the status.
Server status 5xx is raised as an Error.Record.
An error in the token response body is raised as Error.Record.
Return table meta sets Documentation.Name for the function.
Parameter meta sets Documentation.FieldCaption, Documentation.FieldDescription, and Documentation.SampleValues.
Workspace rows are listed at runtime from the API response.
Workspace rows are folders with IsLeaf false whose Data opens model navigation tables.
Model rows are non-leaf views that open label and export navigation tables.
TestConnection returns { "Anaplan.Contents", apiUrl, authUrl }, which names the shared entry function.
TraceContext.pqm and Diagnostics.pqm are loaded with Extension.LoadFunction.
Label comes from Extension.LoadString (localized strings).
Icon16 and Icon32 are loaded with Extension.Contents from PNG files.
Diagnostics.LogValue is defined but no live code calls it; the only other reference is commented out at line 707.
fileDownload polls the export task status through getTaskStatusLoop.
Polls up to MaxAttempts and keeps the first response whose taskState is not TaskInProgress.

polling-rule.text: Polling interval is 10 seconds (#duration(0,0,0,10)) between attempts, with the first attempt immediate. It makes up to 200 attempts, about 33 minutes at most. Terminal state is any taskState other than the localized TaskInProgress string; the first such response is used. If none is found, ErrorTable(2) is returned.

evidence.note: Attempts use Function.InvokeAfter with DelayBetweenAttempts; getTaskStatusLoop(200, #duration(0,0,0,10)) is the call.
Terminal condition is taskState <> TaskInProgress; List.First picks the first match, else null.
The POST to /tasks starts an export job to read data. It is not a write, and no insert, update, or delete actions exist.
